001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007import java.util.Set;
008import java.util.TreeSet;
009
010@HistoryLogProps(
011    opCode = 280,
012    displayName = "Bolus Delivery",
013    internalName = "LID_BOLUS_DELIVERY",
014    usedByAndroid = true
015)
016public class BolusDeliveryHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
017    
018    private int bolusID;
019    private int bolusDeliveryStatusId;
020    private int bolusTypeBitmask;
021    private int bolusSource;
022    private int remoteId;
023    private int requestedNow;
024    private int requestedLater;
025    private int correction;
026    private int extendedDurationRequested;
027    private int deliveredTotal;
028    
029    public BolusDeliveryHistoryLog() {}
030    
031    public BolusDeliveryHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusID, int bolusDeliveryStatusId, Set<BolusType> bolusTypes, BolusSource bolusSource, int remoteId, int requestedNow, int requestedLater, int correction, int extendedDurationRequested, int deliveredTotal) {
032        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusID, bolusDeliveryStatusId, BolusType.toBitmask(bolusTypes.toArray(new BolusType[]{})), bolusSource.id(), remoteId, requestedNow, requestedLater, correction, extendedDurationRequested, deliveredTotal);
033        this.pumpTimeSec = pumpTimeSec;
034        this.sequenceNum = sequenceNum;
035        this.bolusID = bolusID;
036        this.bolusDeliveryStatusId = bolusDeliveryStatusId;
037        this.bolusTypeBitmask = BolusType.toBitmask(bolusTypes.toArray(new BolusType[]{}));
038        this.bolusSource = bolusSource.id();
039        this.remoteId = remoteId;
040        this.requestedNow = requestedNow;
041        this.requestedLater = requestedLater;
042        this.correction = correction;
043        this.extendedDurationRequested = extendedDurationRequested;
044        this.deliveredTotal = deliveredTotal;
045        
046    }
047
048    public int typeId() {
049        return 280;
050    }
051
052    /**
053     * <table border="1">
054     * <caption>Parsed fields for BolusDeliveryHistoryLog:</caption>
055     * <tr><td><code>bolusID</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
056     * <tr><td><code>bolusDeliveryStatusId</code></td><td><code>raw[12]</code></td></tr>
057     * <tr><td><code>bolusTypeBitmask</code></td><td><code>raw[13]</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>bolusSource</code></td><td><code>raw[14]</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>remoteId</code></td><td><code>raw[15] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
060     * <tr><td><code>requestedNow</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
061     * <tr><td><code>requestedLater</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
062     * <tr><td><code>correction</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 20)</code></td></tr>
063     * <tr><td><code>extendedDurationRequested</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
064     * <tr><td><code>deliveredTotal</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 24)</code></td></tr>
065     * </table>
066     */
067    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
068        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
069        this.cargo = raw;
070        parseBase(raw);
071        this.bolusID = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
072        this.bolusDeliveryStatusId = raw[12];
073        this.bolusTypeBitmask = raw[13];
074        this.bolusSource = raw[14];
075        this.remoteId = raw[15] & 0xFF;
076        this.requestedNow = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
077        this.requestedLater = Bytes.readShort(raw, 18);
078        this.correction = Bytes.readShort(raw, 20);
079        this.extendedDurationRequested = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
080        this.deliveredTotal = Bytes.readShort(raw, 24);
081    }
082
083    
084    /**
085     * <table border="1">
086     * <caption>Byte layout for BolusDeliveryHistoryLog.buildCargo(...):</caption>
087     * <tr><th>Offset</th><th>Description</th></tr>
088     * <tr><td>0</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
089     * <tr><td>1</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
090     * <tr><td>2</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
091     * <tr><td>3</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
092     * <tr><td>4</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
093     * <tr><td>5</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
094     * <tr><td>6</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
095     * <tr><td>7</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
096     * <tr><td>8</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusID) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
097     * <tr><td>9</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusID) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
098     * <tr><td>10</td><td><code>(byte) bolusDeliveryStatus</code></td></tr>
099     * <tr><td>11</td><td><code>(byte) bolusType</code></td></tr>
100     * <tr><td>12</td><td><code>(byte) bolusSource</code></td></tr>
101     * <tr><td>13</td><td><code>(byte) remoteId</code></td></tr>
102     * <tr><td>14</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(requestedNow) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
103     * <tr><td>15</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(requestedNow) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
104     * <tr><td>16</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(requestedLater) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
105     * <tr><td>17</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(requestedLater) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
106     * <tr><td>18</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(correction) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
107     * <tr><td>19</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(correction) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
108     * <tr><td>20</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(extendedDurationRequested) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
109     * <tr><td>21</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(extendedDurationRequested) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
110     * <tr><td>22</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(deliveredTotal) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
111     * <tr><td>23</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(deliveredTotal) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
112     * </table>
113     */
114    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusID, int bolusDeliveryStatus, int bolusType, int bolusSource, int remoteId, int requestedNow, int requestedLater, int correction, int extendedDurationRequested, int deliveredTotal) {
115        return Bytes.combine(
116            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(280, 0), // 280 across 2 bytes
117            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
118            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
119            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusID), 
120            new byte[]{ (byte) bolusDeliveryStatus }, 
121            new byte[]{ (byte) bolusType }, 
122            new byte[]{ (byte) bolusSource }, 
123            new byte[]{ (byte) remoteId },
124            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(requestedNow),
125            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(requestedLater), 
126            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(correction), 
127            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(extendedDurationRequested), 
128            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(deliveredTotal));
129    }
130    
131    public int getBolusID() {
132        return bolusID;
133    }
134    public int getBolusDeliveryStatusId() {
135        return bolusDeliveryStatusId;
136    }
137    public int getBolusTypeBitmask() {
138        return bolusTypeBitmask;
139    }
140    public int getBolusSourceId() {
141        return bolusSource;
142    }
143    /**
144     * Byte 15, named {@code remoteId} in Tandem's data export. In every record observed so far it
145     * equals {@code bolusId & 0xFF} (312/312 records in a Mobi capture and all earlier t:slim X2
146     * fixtures), i.e. the low byte of the bolus ID echoed back. Previously exposed as
147     * {@link #getReserved()}; see https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/78.
148     */
149    public int getRemoteId() {
150        return remoteId;
151    }
152    /**
153     * @deprecated byte 15 is not reserved; use {@link #getRemoteId()}.
154     */
155    @Deprecated
156    public int getReserved() {
157        return getRemoteId();
158    }
159    public int getRequestedNow() {
160        return requestedNow;
161    }
162    public int getRequestedLater() {
163        return requestedLater;
164    }
165    public int getCorrection() {
166        return correction;
167    }
168    public int getExtendedDurationRequested() {
169        return extendedDurationRequested;
170    }
171    public int getDeliveredTotal() {
172        return deliveredTotal;
173    }
174
175    public BolusSource getBolusSource() {
176        return BolusSource.fromId(bolusSource);
177    }
178
179    public enum BolusSource {
180        QUICK_BOLUS(0),
181        GUI(1),
182        CONTROL_IQ_AUTO_BOLUS(7),
183        BLUETOOTH_REMOTE_BOLUS(8),
184
185        ;
186        private int id;
187        BolusSource(int id) {
188            this.id = id;
189        }
190        public int id() {
191            return id;
192        }
193        public static BolusSource fromId(int id) {
194            for (BolusSource b : values()) {
195                if (b.id == id) return b;
196            }
197            return null;
198        }
199    }
200
201    public Set<BolusType> getBolusTypes() {
202        return BolusType.fromBitmask(getBolusTypeBitmask());
203    }
204
205    /**
206     * Bitmask decoded from {@code bolusTypeBitmask} (byte offset 13). The mapping below was
207     * validated by cross-correlating every opcode-280 record in a 48k-record real-pump capture
208     * against its bolus's opcode-64 ({@link BolusRequestedMsg1HistoryLog}) and opcode-66
209     * (BolusRequestedMsg3HistoryLog) records by bolus ID: {@code CARB} agreed with MSG1's
210     * carb amount being nonzero, {@code CORRECTION} agreed with MSG1's correction-included flag
211     * and MSG3's correction bolus size being nonzero, and {@code OVERRIDE} agreed with MSG2's
212     * user-override flag, across all 286 boluses observed. {@code NOW} was set on every record
213     * in the capture. The capture contained no extended or eating-soon-mode boluses, so
214     * {@code LATER} and {@code EATING_SOON_MODE} are ported from tconnectsync's semantics but
215     * remain unexercised against real pump data.
216     *
217     * <p>The previous {@code FOOD1(1)/CORRECTION(2)/EXTENDED(4)/FOOD2(8)} mapping could not
218     * explain the observed bit-16 (carb) values and its bit-2 value never appeared in the
219     * capture; see https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/78.
220     */
221    public enum BolusType {
222        NOW(1),
223        LATER(2),
224        OVERRIDE(4),
225        CORRECTION(8),
226        CARB(16),
227        EATING_SOON_MODE(32),
228        ;
229        private int mask;
230        BolusType(int mask) {
231            this.mask = mask;
232        }
233        public int mask() {
234            return mask;
235        }
236        public static Set<BolusType> fromBitmask(int bitmask) {
237            Set<BolusType> ret = new TreeSet<>();
238            for (BolusType b : values()) {
239                if ((bitmask & b.mask()) != 0) {
240                    ret.add(b);
241                }
242            }
243            return ret;
244        }
245        public static int toBitmask(BolusType ...types) {
246            int bitmask = 0;
247            for (BolusType b : types) {
248                bitmask |= b.mask();
249            }
250            return bitmask;
251        }
252    }
253    
254}
